snippet.title: BattleSpinners - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The free BattleSpinners demo is out now on Steam! Wishlist the game 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4324770/

Launch your spinner, aim true, and knock your rivals out of the arena!
BattleSpinners is a pixel art spinning-top battler for up to 4 players, local couch play against friends or bots, and online through Steam Remote Play Together.

🌀 Build your spinner part by part
⚔️ Master your momentum and outclass your opponents
⚡ 16 abilities to combine, 40 unique parts, 3 launchers
🏆 Solo or team Versus, Arcade, Horde, Boss fights, and visual novel Story mode are available in the demo

Free demo available November 11, 2026 on Windows and Linux.
Full game coming in 2027.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4324770/
💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/fsGA7gECzQ 
🌐 Website & press kit: https://battlespinnersgame.com/press

Your feedback on the demo means a lot. Come talk to us on Discord!

#BattleSpinners #IndieGame #PixelArt #LocalMultiplayer #SteamDemo #Godot
